summary: +3 to attack and damage rolls; it can become a Simple Melee weapon, Battleaxe, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar or Warhammer, and once a day a missed attack can be rerolled.
text: You have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon. When you take the Attack action you can turn it into any Simple Melee weapon, a Battleaxe, a Longsword, a Rapier, a Scimitar or a Warhammer until the start of your next turn. Choose Strength or Dexterity for its attack and damage rolls in any shape (the game uses the better). Once per dawn, when you miss with an attack using it, you can roll the attack again and use the new roll.

powers.name: Reshape
powers.text: As you attack: it becomes another weapon until the start of your next turn.

powers.name: Second Try
powers.text: Once a day, offered after a missed attack with it: roll again and use the new roll.
